name: Lupini beans
description: Brined yellow beans sold as street snacks — bitter unless soaked for days.

ayurveda.note: Bitter and drying; read as ushna.

unani.note: Turmus is garam-khushk in the Arab record, taken as a bitter tonic.

histamine.note: Sold in brine after a long soak — the brining is what lifts it.
